content: {"episode_id":"ep-05161","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-22 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, consistent with diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. Given the history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, coded G45.9, the note states that prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness. On these grounds we request reconsideration of the denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 427.5."}
